notes.title: Major Update 0.9.0.8
notes.notes:
Hi guys!


Hello everyone, glad to be back with good news! After having the new version in testing for three weeks and many of you giving feedback through Discord. From now, you have the new version 0.9.0.8 available in the main branch. And 50% OFF!!!

This version is a great version for us since it brings together a lot of what we have been working on during this time and also the feedback provided by the community. This version is the base we needed to focus on the roadmap of the next steps and keep working with you on the next updates of BMX The Game.

The objectives are still clear, and although the path is never always the way you want it to be, we still have the strength and desire to make a better game every day.

Being in Early Access has given us the opportunity to reiterate and adapt to your needs. As developers, the opportunity to receive your feedback, especially through Discord, complements us and will continue to be a key element in our development. For all those who are not yet on the Discord channel, do not hesitate to enter.

[previewyoutube=1kIs6U7R1Uw;full][/previewyoutube]

The new version not only has bug fixes and various tweaks, it also has a new Scenario Import Feature, which we'll explain below along with everything we've worked on.

Patch Notes

 Slowmo: New UI to know when you are in slow-mo.
 Footjam: Recovered the foot jam with the triggers.
 Replayer: Added small features in the "UI".
 Rider: Fixed stiffness bugs and new body configuration that make it more natural and with more flexibility.
 Custom Parks: We have created an easy tool to create your own park or scene for BMX The Game.
 Gameplay improvements: A huge number of tweaks, fixes, and adjustments.

You can use your favorite 3D application/software (such as Blender, 3dsmax, Sketchup...) to design your park. If you don't have specific knowledge of any 3D application, you can also use ProBuilder, which is already configured within the project. You can also set the scene lighting and environment. Use your own textures and any external 3D assets if you like.
The project is on GitHub, ready to build a custom park in Unity and then test it in BMX The Game 0.9.0.8 or later.

This system is completely new and it is in the testing phase.

Known issues:

 The replays recorded in the new Featured Park, if they are saved and played from the Media option of the Menu, the pieces of the park do not appear.
 The tutorial videos have been outdated, we are working on an entirely new tutorial.
 There are still some bugs in the flow of the gameplay, due to the mixing of various systems. This is mainly what we have been working on these last few months.
 We hope you like this new update, and again, thanks for all the support. Keep the feedback coming, we are working on it!



Thank you all! Stay tuned!
Barspin Studios Team

notes.title: 0.9.0.4 Update (Not Major) - Previous Patch
notes.notes:
Hi guys!


We are back with a new version! This version has been a few weeks in the Beta branch and tested by the Discord community.

After a long time, we are back with new updates and news. If you want to be more in the loop, remember to enter Discord.

This update is the result of all the feedback collected by the community and implemented with the aim of making the game more accessible, stable, and predictable.

For this, we have changed endless internal systems and processes, such as the cameras, much more stable to improve the experience, the controls, simplified and direct so that everyone adapts easily, in addition to various guides and help, to facilitate and improve the gameplay and of course, a lot of optimization work has been done.

We explain a little more about the most significant changes:

 Cameras: The cameras have been redone, aiming to be smoother and more stable.
 Gameplay: Hundreds of values ​​have been adjusted. Speeds, times, and forces have been calibrated to the maximum. With the aim of improving and balancing the user experience.
 Tricks: Apart from fixing many bugs, animations, and adjustments, new tricks have been introduced that extend the gaming experience.
 Flips: The flip system is entirely new, just doing a double flick up or down with the left stick and holding the gesture before leaving a ramp will allow you to jump off by launching a flip, without interrupting the possibility of doing other tricks in the air while you flip.
 Server: Since we put in the sharing features, the server has been giving problems, we have thought of a new system for the future, but for now, we have solved part of the problem, and currently sharing parks and downloading them is operational again.
 Trick Control & Layout: The Layout of the controller has changed a bit, the pin dropper, the brake, and something else due to the change in concept when performing tricks. Regarding the controls, there were many of you who asked for a change in the performance of tricks, for a simpler, faster system that would be easy for you to adapt to. For this, we have had to change the entire root system and we hope that this change is good for everyone.
 Skinning, Poses & Animations: A lot of work has been tweaked and redone around this, and many really annoying visual bugs have been improved and removed.
 Bugs: It is really impossible to try to list all the bugs, but to give you an idea, everything has been covered and improved. Bugs in Grinds, in Backwards, in performance we have worked on everything and more, in lighting many things and we are still playing for the next version, problems with controls, pin dropper etc...


And the known issues to solve in the future:

 We have not indicated in the Layout that to enter and exit Slow Motion by pressing L3.
 The replays recorded in the new Featured Park, if they are saved and played from the Media option of the Menu, the pieces of the park do not appear.
 The tutorial videos have been outdated, we are working on a completely new tutorial.
 As we have not been able to introduce all the new riding systems, there are still some bugs or strange in the flow of the gameplay, due to the mixing of various systems. This is mainly what we are working on these last few months.


Above all, it is necessary to look at the new Control Layout, since it has changed quite a bit. The trick system, the pin dropper, and how to save and load a mark is very important. We attach them here as well to make it faster for you to check them out.

notes.title: 0.8.0.18 Update (Not Major) - Previous Patch
notes.notes:
Hi Riders!


As we have already been commenting these days, we update the game again adding 3 new scenarios to edit in the Park Editor, the Born, the Bike Tunnel, and the novelty of the Outdoor Park, still without a name (we accept proposals!). In addition, we have added a new Featured Park, courtesy of FreHDGaming that has been designed exclusively for this Outdoor scenario. We look forward to your creations for the next Featured Parks!

As you will see, the new version is 0.8.0.18 since we are improving many internal things, especially the riding and the detection system. Soon we will have everything ready for a new Major Update (with many improvements).

In this patch we have put a lot of work into optimization, it was clearly one of our weaknesses. To improve this, we have made several decisions:

The first thing we have done has been to improve and optimize the game, without reducing qualities (File size, load times, general performance improvement, FPS increase, memory resource reduction, etc). It has been a difficult and slow process but we believe it has been worth it.

On the other hand, what we have done is separate the city from the main branch and pass it to Beta. Not everyone has a PC to be able to play the city of Barcelona (in development). Having two branches, we greatly lighten the main branch and allow you to individually test one or the other and decide which branch is suitable for your PC.

The two branches contain the same core and production status, the only difference between them is the city. In the main branch (0.8.0.18) the city is removed, allowing a better overall performance experience.

In the Beta branch (0.8.0.17) the city is as always, under development. We continue working to optimize the city and improve the experience.

They have been intense months and we have worked very hard. We hope to show you soon everything that has been done in the Major Update. As we do not know the exact date of publication of the Major, we will update you with videos, images or texts on the #development channel and thus you will be informed of everything.

We hope you enjoy the update and thank you again for all the support you are giving us. We share a small video summary with several improvements that we have been making these months. 

Video: INSTAGRAM

Take care dudes, and enjoy the new version!

Barspin Studios Team

notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:
Hi Riders!


Almost a month since we updated the game. Now, Winter Update is real. We’ve made a lot of efforts to bring this new version and 30% off! It’s a tough situation, working from home and not being able to be with the team, but the Barspin Studios team is doing its best to keep improving the game in every patch. This update is the last of 2020, an amazing year for us, releasing the Early Access of BMX The Game to still making it together with you and the rest of the community.

We upgraded our Game Engine, better physics (aerials, riding, spins, tricks, helpers, etc.), new tricks, the famous Pin Dropper, Winter clothes (and special Xmas wear), we improved the performance of the game (note that the city doesn’t work correctly until we finish it, so please, read the disclaimer on the Loading screen), a new Featured Park, now you can change your rider skin, freecoaster (finally!!) and much more! Maybe you’ll have a slow download, please, be patient, this new version has new files built on a better Game Engine. If you switch between different game updates (from other games), your velocity will increase!

In the last 4 months, we’ve made a big effort to still developing the game, thanks for supporting our work. These days we’ll rest a bit, taking energy for the next year. We have a lot of new ideas, updates in mind and more stuff! Just stay with us and keep giving us your help, we’ll make the BMX game that you are waiting for! Let’s do it!

notes.title: Patch 0.7.1.10, big improvements!! No input lag! 😃
notes.notes:
THANK YOU for all the feedback that you gave us! We have listened to you, we have seen a lot of bugs, gameplay issues and performance problems, and most of them have been fixed.

Bye bye input lag!

We’re working a lot to solve a big performance issue 💪. It’s harder than we thought, so we need more days to face it. We’ve played fine on a GTX750 (to test it) but because of this bug, other people with high-end computers (2080s and so) are experiencing severe fps drops. We have some clues about what systems are involved and we’re working on it, let’s do it!

These are our first steps of this new era for Barspin Studios. We’re happy with the result of the first tweaks based on your feedback and ideas 🙏. There’s a lot of work to do but we're fully engaged and working full hard. We can’t wait to see where we’re heading.

Patch notes:

 Reduced drastically the time between a gesture is done and animation is triggered.
 Increased centripetal inertia.
 Most glitches on decals are fixed
 The garage is now bigger to keep your creations
 Decals in the city are now more combined to reduce memory usage and draw calls.
 Fixed a bug that causes hundreds of cloned materials.
 City boundaries are now solid, so we avoid problems on respawn on the first mark.
 Rebake of some terrains and many small fixes in the city.
 Pool system, which controls the objects that appear in the city, like trees, foliage and cars, has been rewritten to reduce CPU impact.
 As well, the main config of the pool system has been tweaked to improve performance.
 We have introduced popups to make the experience by the game features in progress less frustrating.
 Added a tag to make it easier to support people who send us images or videos.
 Added a featured park especially for those people who have bad performance in the city, while we are fixing and increasing performance they can play on a Featured Park.
 Fixed problems with computers with more than one controller. Now the first gamepad you touch will be the first controller. No more incompatibilities with wheels connected and so.
 Ride menu to select different places to go to. We have added Featured Park. Here we will put a selected park from the community that we like. We have required some specs and creators are starting to work on it. We’re starting to receive parks, we will pick one at some point of the next week. Meanwhile, we have added an example park made by us using the Park Editor.
 Tweaked Shadows configs.
 By default, it starts at 720p resolution, because many people have low-end computers. If you want higher resolutions you have to select it on Options Menu.
 The Tournament is disabled until coming updates with a first testing version.
 Cannot ride in lakes.
 Disabled particles effects because they are causing glitches.
 Locked pedals on nose manual fakie.
